assumptions: This is a hardcoded fixture used when VITE_USE_MOCK_DATA=true — replace this file with real Suggestion Agent output to demo actual generation.

suggestions.title: Sole Canyon Dive
suggestions.genre: first-person canyon-dive descent through the shoe's own midsole layers
suggestions.one_line_pitch: Dive through the exploded layers of our newest sole and land the perfect stride.
core_loop: Camera free-falls through a canyon built from the shoe's foam/midsole cross-section
Steer left/right through gaps in the layered geometry
Time a final landing on a glowing footprint pad to score a stride bonus
suggestions.spatial_design: A true vertical descent — camera dollies downward through foreground rock-like foam formations, midground gap obstacles, and a background glow that grows as you approach the landing pad.
suggestions.brand_integration: The canyon walls are literally extruded from the shoe's midsole cross-section geometry and textured with the product image if supplied.
suggestions.conversion_mechanic: Landing within the glowing pad on the final drop unlocks a redemption code rendered on a 3D reward plinth.
suggestions.marketing_alignment: Awareness-oriented: the product's own construction is the entire visual centerpiece from frame one.
suggestions.shareability_hook: The camera flash + slow-mo landing moment on a perfect stride.
suggestions.visual_style_direction: Warm rim-lit canyon walls in brand orange, moody dark background, subtle bloom on the landing pad glow.
suggestions.cta_placement: Persistent small brand badge top-left during play; large CTA button on game-over screen.

suggestions.title: Aisle Sprint 3000
suggestions.genre: lane-weaving sprint down a store aisle built from real packaging geometry
suggestions.one_line_pitch: Sprint down our own store aisle, dodging endcaps, chasing the drop.
core_loop: Player character sprints forward down a 3-lane store aisle
Swipe/steer between lanes to dodge shelf endcaps and grab floating product icons
Speed ramps up with every 10 points collected
suggestions.spatial_design: Camera rides just behind and above the runner with real depth — shelves recede into the background, endcaps loom in midground, collectibles glint in the foreground lane.
suggestions.brand_integration: Shelf and endcap geometry is modeled after the brand's actual product packaging silhouette, not generic boxes.
suggestions.conversion_mechanic: Reaching 50 points spawns an in-aisle 'today only' sign that reveals a real redemption code when the player runs through it.
suggestions.marketing_alignment: Foot-traffic goal: a QR code on the game-over screen redeems in-store, tying the run directly to a physical visit.
suggestions.shareability_hook: A visible personal-best banner and a 'beat this score' share button.
suggestions.visual_style_direction: Bright, glossy shelf materials, punchy brand-color accent lighting, light vignette for speed sensation.
suggestions.cta_placement: CTA button + QR-style code block on the game-over screen.

suggestions.title: Mascot Orbit Rally
suggestions.genre: orbit-and-launch trick game around a giant mascot centerpiece
suggestions.one_line_pitch: Orbit our mascot, time your launch, stick the trick.
core_loop: Camera orbits a large stylized mascot model at the center of the scene
Player times a launch off the mascot's arm to fly through a ring gauntlet
Score multiplies with clean ring chains before landing back on the mascot
suggestions.spatial_design: Full orbital camera around a large foreground hero object, with a distant background skyline for scale contrast and rings arranged in true 3D depth around the mascot.
suggestions.brand_integration: The mascot model is the literal launch mechanic and centerpiece — not a background prop.
suggestions.conversion_mechanic: A clean 5-ring chain unlocks a shareable mascot 'skin' plus a redemption code shown on a trophy podium camera beat.
suggestions.marketing_alignment: Social virality goal: the ring-chain peak moment is designed to be screenshot-worthy, with a built-in challenge-a-friend share button.
suggestions.shareability_hook: The trophy podium camera beat after a clean chain, framed for a screenshot.
suggestions.visual_style_direction: Glossy toy-like mascot material, saturated brand-color rim light, light bloom on ring trails.
suggestions.cta_placement: Small persistent brand mark on the mascot's chest; full CTA on the trophy screen.
